facts.value: UL faculty participating in Erasmus+ Staff Mobility for Teaching must ensure that the receiving institution is a university with whom the University of Limerick has a signed 'inter-institutional' agreement.
facts.programme_association: European Studies - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: Check with UL Global prior to submitting your application to ensure the institution to which you are considering travelling holds a valid mobility agreement with UL.
facts.programme_association: European Studies - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: A funded duration for staff mobility must be a minimum of 2 days (excluding travel) and a maximum of 7 days (including travel).
facts.programme_association: European Studies - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: UL faculty attending a partner institution as part of Erasmus+ Staff Mobility for Teaching must fulfil a minimum of 8 teaching hours per week during their mobility.
facts.programme_association: European Studies - BA | University of Limerick
